notes: New in the studio: Jobs. Every morning a job search in your private repository looks for new postings that fit the role types, places and limits in jobs/preferences.json, ranks them against your graph's skills, and lists them here with the reasons and warnings (for example German required). From each you can write a CV and letter, add it to Applications, save it or set it aside.
The job search is a GitHub Actions workflow (Job search) in your private repository; it uses the Federal Employment Agency's public job database, so it currently covers Germany.
